title: Understanding the Column Space
text: The column space of a matrix X is the set of all possible linear combinations of its column vectors. If a vector v is in the column space of X, it means that v can be expressed as a linear combination of the columns of X.

title: Properties of the Hat Matrix
text: The hat matrix H is an idempotent matrix, meaning that $$H H=H$$. It is also symmetric, so $$H=H^T$$. These properties are useful when analyzing how H interacts with vectors in the column space of X.
